why: Both proposals share six identical pieces, so the choice comes down to the side table. A's walnut-toned nesting tables echo the warm wood of the floor and the natural textiles, and they hold a coffee. B's dark espresso side table with a lower shelf is heavy next to the leather armchair and jute rug, and it adds a third dark piece beside the bookcase and floor, so it clashes with the warm, natural look the client wants.
